item.title: "Electricity Rates Frozen Amid Middle East Energy Crisis…A Bigger Bill for Future Generations" (“중동발 에너지 위기 속 전기요금 동결…미래세대에 더 큰 청구서”)
item.description:
"Freezing electricity rates and continuing to sell below cost despite the Middle East energy crisis is not for the people, but merely deferring a larger bill to future generations." <<> At the '9th Energy Justice Forum for Social Consensus' held on the 6th by the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute (Director Jo Hyeon-kyung) at the Hankyoreh Cheongam Hall in Mapo-gu, Seoul, under the theme 'Energy Crisis, Electricity Rates, and Market Improvement Tasks,' participants from academia, the economic sector, civil society, and public enterprises expressed concern that despite a sharp rise in power generation costs amid the energy crisis triggered by the Middle East war, the government and political circles—driven by political logic focused on inflation and elections—are freezing electricity rates and selling below cost, which will impose a heavier burden on future generations. They particularly emphasized that KEPCO's debt, which surged from around 100 trillion won to 200 trillion won during the 2022 Russia-Ukraine war, is now rapidly increasing to 300-400 trillion won due to this Middle East crisis. This prevents KEPCO from making urgent power grid investments, inevitably delaying the expansion of renewable energy and the energy transition, and failing to incentivize rational energy consumption. Forum participants pointed to policy alternatives such as normalizing electricity rates for residential and agricultural use (currently sold below cost), establishing an independent and professional power regulatory agency to prevent electricity rates from being decided by political logic, and providing financial support for vulnerable groups. <<> At the forum, Seok Kwang-hoon, a specialist committee member of the Energy Transition Forum (and member of the Electricity Commission), and Professor Jeong Yeon-je of Seoul National University of Science and Technology gave presentations. The discussion was moderated by Professor Jeon Young-hwan of Hongik University, with participants including Professor Baek Cheol-woo of Duksung Women's University, Jo Young-joon, head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry's Sustainable Management Institute, Kim Hee-sung, chairman of Bright Energy Partners, Cheon Hyeon-min, head of KEPCO's Rate Strategy Division, and Kim Yang-ji, head of the Power Market Division at the Ministry of Climate and Energy. There were also congratulatory remarks from Kim Chang-seop, chairman of the Electricity Commission, and a welcome speech by Park Chan-soo, CEO of the Hankyoreh. The Energy Justice Forum was launched in 2022 with the aim of achieving social consensus by setting aside political approaches centered on ruling vs. opposition parties, ideology, and factionalism, and instead thinking of the future and future generations to succeed in carbon neutrality and the energy transition. <<> ■ KEPCO Debt Expected to Reach 300-400 Trillion Won <<> Specialist Seok Kwang-hoon predicted, "According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), the oil supply shock from a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz after the Middle East war would be 11 million barrels per day, equivalent to the combined shocks of the two oil crises in the 1970s. The liquefied natural gas (LNG) supply shock would be 87 million tons, twice the shock Europe experienced (40 million tons) during the 2022 Russia-Ukraine war. Even after the war ends, supply disruptions are likely to persist for several years due to damage to production facilities and delayed repairs." LNG supply disruptions drive up international spot market prices. Seok analyzed, "JKM, the benchmark for Northeast Asian LNG spot prices, has nearly doubled from $10-11 just before the war to nearly $20 recently. This is expected to intensify from late June to early July as winter imports increase." The rise in LNG spot prices leads, with a time lag, to an increase in the System Marginal Price (SMP), which is KEPCO's power purchase cost. This is because the unit cost of LNG power generation, which accounts for 27.4% of Korea's total power generation (as of 2025), dictates the SMP. During the 2022 Russia-Ukraine war, international LNG prices surged, tripling the SMP, but the Yoon Suk Yeol government failed to reflect this properly in electricity rates and continued selling electricity below cost, causing KEPCO's debt to balloon. <<> Professor Jeong Yeon-je pointed out, "Through the Russia-Ukraine war, KEPCO's consolidated debt surged from the mid-100 trillion won range to 206 trillion won (as of end of 2025), with annual interest costs alone exceeding 4 trillion won (11.9 billion won per day). Interest is being added to the principal, and interest is accruing on interest." He noted, "At that time, the UK, France, and Japan each implemented policies of suppressing, freezing, or subsidizing electricity rates, but ultimately, artificially suppressing prices does not solve the problem—it merely postpones it to the future, leaving a lesson that it returns as a larger bill for future generations through rate hikes and tax increases. In contrast, Germany adopted a method of protecting basic electricity demand while suppressing excess demand, simultaneously achieving the protection of energy-poor households and voluntary energy savings." <<> Specialist Seok Kwang-hoon diagnosed, "The government under Lee Jae-myung is also expected to suppress electricity rate hikes. The shock from this Middle East war is greater than in 2022, and KEPCO's debt is projected to more than double, making it unmanageable." This is a warning about the risk of KEPCO's debt rapidly escalating to 300-400 trillion won. Professor Jeong Yeon-je pointed out, "Driven by political logic conscious of elections and inflation, residential electricity rates are maintained at levels far below cost even in normal times, blocking price signals. If rates do not rise, there is no incentive to save electricity, making government measures like vehicle operation restrictions and appeals for power conservation difficult to be effective." He stated, "The increase in KEPCO's debt is not just a financial problem; it makes key investments that KEPCO must undertake—such as transmission and distribution network maintenance, integration of renewable energy into the power grid, and grid stabilization—impossible. Freezing electricity rates now and handing down an older, more vulnerable power grid to future generations raises issues of energy security and intergenerational equity." <<> Cheon Hyeon-min, a KEPCO director, said in the discussion, "During the Russia-Ukraine war, major foreign countries immediately reflected the increase in power generation costs in electricity rates. However, in our case, reflecting the costs was delayed due to concerns about inflation, and adjustments were centered on large-scale industrial rates, leading KEPCO to face the worst-case scenario of rapidly ballooning debt." Industrial electricity rates were raised a total of 72.6 won/kWh over seven occasions from 2022 to 2024, but residential rates rose by only half that amount, 40.4 won/kWh. Cheon analyzed, "While industrial power consumption has decreased since 2022 due to demand slowdown from the economic downturn, consumption in residential and other sectors has increased significantly. This is the result of price signals not working." <<> Chairman Kim Hee-sung pointed out, "True energy security is not about short-term price suppression but about establishing resilience so the system can flexibly respond to external shocks, and creating investment incentives for capital to cycle into future infrastructure. The current artificial price control distorts market price signals, hinders resource allocation efficiency, and ultimately risks undermining the stability of the power system." He stated, "The board of KEPCO, a listed company with numerous foreign, national pension fund, and private investors as shareholders, continuing to accept a rate system that is significantly below cost raises serious concerns regarding shareholder value protection. Innovation in the energy industry is only complete when its value is proven in the capital market, beyond technological achievements. To achieve this, electricity rates must be recognized not as something to be controlled, but as a key price signal for system maintenance and advancement." <<> ■ Three Major Tasks: Rate Normalization, Depoliticization, and Support for Vulnerable Groups <<> Specialist Seok Kwang-hoon proposed a plan for the prompt liquidation of KEPCO's debt (over 200 trillion won), involving the government taking over KEPCO's transmission and distribution sector and simultaneously normalizing electricity rates. He suggested, "KEPCO could partially resolve its debt with the proceeds from selling the transmission and distribution sector and be restructured into a private electricity retailer. At the same time, residential, educational, and agricultural electricity rates, which are sold below cost, should be normalized by about 50%." He also proposed, "The complexity of the power market and information asymmetry have become too great to be managed by a system controlled by a few public officials and politicians. The government and political circles must hand over rate-setting authority to a specialized regulatory agency." <<> Professor Jeong Yeon-je presented three policy alternatives: normalization of electricity rates, depoliticization of rate decisions, and protection of vulnerable groups. He urged, "Rate normalization is a key tool for responding to the energy crisis. A phased path for rate normalization should be designed based on the principle of total cost recovery." He emphasized, "As long as the structure where political logic, conscious of elections and inflation, repeatedly undermines the cost recovery principle does not change, the problem will persist. A system where cost fluctuations, such as fuel costs, are automatically reflected in rates should be introduced, and rate-setting authority should be granted to an institution independent of politics." He stated, "Protecting vulnerable groups should be resolved through direct financial support, such as vouchers or subsidies." <<> Professor Baek Cheol-woo stated, "The first step toward normalizing price signals is normalizing the fuel cost adjustment system. For the 'fuel cost adjustment unit price' (a component of electricity rates), the quarterly adjustment limit is narrowly set at ±3 won/kWh, and the annual cumulative limit at ±5 won/kWh, which significantly restricts the price signal transmission function during periods of drastic fuel cost changes. The adjustment limit for the fuel cost adjustment unit price should be abolished or greatly expanded." He pointed out, "While rate increases for industrial use have progressed significantly, cost recovery rates for residential, educational, and agricultural use remain low. Reflecting social values like food security and public education is necessary, but currently, the burden is shifted to consumers in other contract categories, such as industrial use, through a cross-subsidization method." He proposed, "KEPCO should disclose the cost recovery formula for each rate type, and the system should be converted to one where support is provided directly from the budget." Professor Baek further stated, "I strongly agree with the need to establish an independent regulatory agency, and the current push to create a Power Supervisory Authority is timely. Legislation is needed for an automatic cost-linked adjustment mechanism (automatic reflection of fuel cost changes), granting voting rights to the Electricity Commission, and abolishing or minimizing the consultation with the Ministry of Economy and Finance on price matters." Regarding KEPCO's separation of transmission/distribution and opening of the retail market, he said, "I sympathize with the direction, but the specific plan requires careful thought. Various factors must be considered, such as the sharp decline in KEPCO's corporate value, the potential exercise of appraisal rights by foreign, institutional, and minority shareholders, and the handling of debts (88 trillion won) from the six generation subsidiaries." <<> KEPCO Director Cheon Hyeon-min stated, "Electricity rates should be based on the cost principle, and independent authority should be granted to the relevant regulatory body to ensure the costs of power generation are reflected in a timely manner. The current fuel cost adjustment system, which operates within limited bounds, should be improved to allow for the timely reflection of fluctuating international fuel prices. The energy transition costs, expected to increase with the expansion of renewable energy and energy storage systems, must also be reflected in the climate and environmental charges." He emphasized, "A phased normalization of rates for residential and other consumer categories, beyond just industrial use, is necessary. The impact of the energy supply chain crisis from the recent Middle East war has not yet been fully reflected in rate costs, but it is a risk factor that must be considered." <<> Chairman Kim Hee-sung proposed, "Major advanced countries adhere to the principles of regulatory independence and respect for market principles in responding to energy crises. What is needed is strengthening the independence of rate-setting governance, transparent sharing of power grid data, introducing market designs and pricing systems that can create diverse value, and providing direct support through the budget for vulnerable groups." Jo Young-joon, head of the Sustainable Management Institute, stated, "Due to the sharp rise in industrial electricity rates, the proportion of electricity costs relative to production costs in major industries is continuously expanding, accelerating companies' efforts to reduce power costs. However, the basis for calculating the grid charges that make up the electricity rate and the cost items constituting the supplementary settlement are not disclosed, reducing companies' ability to predict costs. The predictability and transparency of electricity rate and market policies must be increased." Regarding the electrification of manufacturing facilities, such as hydrogen-based steelmaking, he suggested, "Referencing cases like Germany's special rate system for electricity-intensive industries and China's fixed-rate system for large manufacturers, support to reduce the rate burden on companies is necessary." <<> Kim Yang-ji, a director at the Climate Department, stated, "The principle for setting electricity rates is cost recovery, and it is operated by comprehensively considering factors such as rate stability, equity, and the impact on the national economy. For vulnerable groups, efforts are being made not only for rate reductions but also for financial support through programs like vouchers." He said, "The government is putting in various efforts, including strengthening the independence of the Electricity Commission and proposing an amendment to the Electricity Business Act to establish a Power Supervisory Authority." <<> Senior Reporter Kwak Jung-soo, Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute, jskwak@hani.co.kr (“중동발 에너지 위기를 맞고도 전기요금을 동결해 원가 이하 판매를 지속하는 것은 국민을 위한 게 아니라, 미래세대에게 더 큰 청구서를 미루는 것이다.”)

item.title: Tokens Become 'Digital Rent'... The More You Pay, the Smarter It Gets? (‘디지털 월세’ 된 토큰…돈 내는 만큼 똑똑해진다?)
item.description:
Applied linguist Dr. Kim Sung-woo recently conducted an experiment on artificial intelligence. (응용언어학자 김성우 박사는 최근 인공지능을 대상으로 실험을 해봤다.)

He instructed two versions—paid and free—of the same AI model to write a draft of "an academic essay reviewing the decolonization of TESOL and critically examining its potential application to the English education context." (“TESOL(국제영어교사 양성과정)의 탈식민화를 개관하고 이를 영어 교육 맥락에 적용할 가능성을 비판적으로 검토하는 학술에세이”의 초안을 써달라는 요청을 동일한 인공지능 모델의 유료·무료 2가지 버전으로 지시했다.)

The responses differed significantly. The free version divided the content into issues such as △the concept of decolonization △problems of knowledge production and curriculum △enhancing the instrumentality of English △adaptability to Korean English education △localization of the curriculum, attaching three to four brief points to each item for a total of three pages (A4 standard). (답변은 차이가 많이 났다. 무료 버전은 △탈식민지화의 개념 △지식생산과 커리큘럼의 문제 △영어의 도구성 제고 △한국 영어교육에의 적응 가능성 △교육과정의 지역화 등을 쟁점으로 구분한 뒤 각 항목마다 서너개의 짧은 요지를 붙여 3쪽(A4 기준)에 담았다.)

The paid version ran to ten pages and included extensive references. It started with an eye-catching question, "Raising the Issue: Decolonization is not about 'abandoning English'," and delved deeply into points such as "It's not about eliminating norms, but teaching the power of norms," "From American and British culture to a linguistic ecology of power," and "Korean English teachers are not deficient native speakers." While the free model produced a plain summary note, the paid version was a well-structured textbook that posed key questions and explained them with concrete examples. (유료 버전은 총 10쪽에 이르렀고 참고 문헌도 풍부했다. “문제제기: 탈식민화는 ‘영어를 버리자는 주장이 아니다’”라는 눈길 끄는 질문에서 출발해 “규범을 없애자는 것이 아니라 규범의 권력을 가르치는 것” “미국·영국 문화에서 권력의 언어생태로” “한국인 영어교사는 결핍된 원어민이 아니다” 처럼 쟁점을 심도있게 정리했다. 무료 모델이 평이한 요약 노트라면, 유료는 핵심 질문을 던지고 구체적 사례로 설명하는 짜임새 있는 교재였다.)

Dr. Kim said, "When I reviewed group activity results in class, I found a significant difference in response length depending on whether students used the paid AI model," adding, "Paying for a subscription can make a big difference in the speed and quality of task completion." (김 박사는 “강의를 하면서 조별 활동 결과물을 봤더니 인공지능 유료 모델 사용 여부에 따라 답변 길이가 상당히 달랐다”며 “돈을 내고 구독을 하느냐에 따라 과제를 처리하는 속도·품질에 큰 차이를 가져올 수 있다”고 말했다.)

As advanced AI rapidly permeates everyday life, the 'AI opportunity gap' is emerging as a key issue. The performance of AI varies according to economic level, leading to widening disparities in learning and work capabilities. While this may be an exaggerated concern, some even suggest that which version you use could affect school grades. (고도화된 인공지능이 빠른 속도로 사람들의 일상에도 스며들면서 ‘인공지능 기회 격차’가 쟁점으로 떠오르고 있다. 경제적 수준에 따라 인공지능의 성능이 달라지고 그만큼 학습·업무 역량도 벌어진다는 것이다. 과장 섞인 우려이긴 하나, 일각에선 어떤 버전을 쓰느냐에 따라 내신성적도 차이 날 수 있다는 얘기까지 나온다.)

The core metric determining the quality of AI services is the 'token'. A token is the basic unit of computation for AI; more complex operations require more tokens, meaning increased time and cost. Just as telecom companies set phone plan fees based on data allowances, AI companies set pricing plans based on token usage. Of course, most AI can be used for free, and the majority of users still rely on free models. However, even without doing complex tasks like coding, those who want to use AI more actively are increasingly switching to paid versions, as paid models are far superior in reasoning, memory, and image and video generation capabilities. (인공지능 서비스 질을 좌우하는 핵심 지표는 ‘토큰’이다. 토큰은 인공지능이 연산을 처리하는 최소 단위로, 더 복잡한 연산을 하기 위해서는 더 많은 토큰이 필요하고 이는 시간과 비용이 늘어난다는 것을 의미한다. 마치 통신사들이 데이터 제공량 기준으로 휴대폰 요금을 책정하는 것처럼, 인공지능 기업들도 토큰 사용량에 따라 요금제를 정한다. 물론 대부분의 인공지능은 무료 사용이 가능하고 여전히 다수 사용자가 무료 모델에 의지하고 있다. 하지만 굳이 코딩처럼 복잡한 업무를 하지 않더라도 인공지능을 좀 더 적극적으로 사용하려는 사람들은 유료로 전환하는 추세다. 유료 모델이 추론·기억·이미지 및 동영상 생성 능력 등에서 훨씬 뛰어나기 때문이다.)

The number of paid users is growing steeply. In the 'Media Panel Survey' (conducted by the Korea Information Society Development Institute) from May to August 2024, 13.7% of all respondents were generative AI users, of which 13.7% were paid users. In the same survey in 2025, the user rate surged to 31.6%, with paid users making up 13% of that. Based on the national population, paid users increased from 1.8% in 2024 to 4.1% in 2025, more than doubling. Like housing and communication costs, AI tokens are likely to become a 'digital rent' fixed living expense, inevitably increasing household burdens. Lee Hae-beom, an AI education instructor who uses the $20-per-month Claude Pro plan, told The Hankyoreh, "I used up all my tokens in five hours preparing materials for a 30-minute lecture," adding, "the pressure from the cost is growing." (유료 이용자 수는 가파르게 느는 추세다. 2024년 5~8월 ‘미디어패널조사’(정보통신정책연구원)에서 생성형 인공지능 이용자는 전체 응답자 중 13.7%였고, 이중 유료 이용자는 13.7%였다. 이듬해 2025년 같은 조사에선 이용자가 31.6%로 급증했고, 이중 유료는 13%였다. 전국민을 기준으로 유료 이용자를 따져보면 2024년 1.8%에서 2025년 4.1%로 2배 이상 늘었다. 주거·통신비처럼 인공지능 토큰 또한 ‘디지털 월세’로 고정 생활비가 될 가능성이 높다. 당연히 가계 부담도 늘어난다. 월 20달러 클로드 프로 요금제를 쓰고 있는 인공지능 교육 강사 이해범씨는 한겨레에 “30분 강의 자료를 준비하는데 5시간 만에 토큰이 다 소진됐다”며 “비용에 대한 압박감이 점점 심해지고 있다”고 말했다.)

An increase in digital rent payers seems inevitable, primarily due to exploding token usage. The center of gravity in the AI industry is shifting from learning to reasoning, and the era of 'agentic AI'—which performs tasks on behalf of users—is fully dawning. Agentic AI consumes far more tokens than before. According to statistics from OpenRouter, an AI model integration platform, the past year has truly been a 'token Big Bang'. Global token usage exceeded 100 billion in August 2024, and just over a year later, in late September, it surpassed 5 trillion. By early February this year, it had soared to 10 trillion, and by late March, to 27 trillion. (디지털 월세 생활자가 늘어나는 건 불가피한 흐름으로 보인다. 우선, 폭발적인 토큰 사용량 때문이다. 인공지능 산업의 무게중심이 학습에서 추론으로 이동하고, 사용자를 대신해 업무를 수행하는 ‘에이전틱 인공지능’ 시대가 본격 도래하고 있다. 에이전트 인공지능은 이전보다 훨씬 더 많은 토큰을 소비한다. 인공지능 모델 통합플랫폼인 오픈라우터 통계를 보면, 최근 1년은 그야말로 ‘토큰 빅뱅’의 시기였다. 전세계 토큰 사용량은 2024년 8월 1000억개를 넘어섰는데 1년여만인 9월 말엔 5조를 돌파했다. 올해 2월초엔 10조, 3월말에는 27조로 치솟았다.)

To meet this surging token demand and survive fierce competition, AI companies need massive infrastructure investment. While companies like Anthropic and OpenAI are seeing rapid revenue growth, they are still operating at a loss. Anthropic is predicted to turn profitable by 2028, and OpenAI by 2030. They inevitably must consider adjusting token prices or introducing advertising. (이처럼 급증하는 토큰 수요를 맞추고 치열한 경쟁에서 살아남기 위해 인공지능 기업은 대규모 인프라 투자를 받아야 한다. 앤트로픽·오픈에이아이의 경우 매출이 빠른 속도로 상승하고 있지만 여전히 적자다. 앤트로픽은 2028년, 오픈에이아이는 2030년에야 흑자로 전환될 것으로 예측된다. 토큰 가격 조정, 광고 도입 등을 고민할 수밖에 없다.)

The direct cost burden from increased token usage is a challenge for both the private and public sectors. Particularly amid a major labor market restructuring, individuals are under intense pressure to build AI capabilities. To prevent them from being left to fend for themselves in this dog-eat-dog world, public support is necessary. Dr. Kim Sung-woo said, "AI is not a service users freely choose but an essential infrastructure like water and electricity, except that the provider is not the public sector but Big Tech," adding, "Just as drinking water of vastly different quality or significantly unstable power supply based on economic conditions would become a social problem, we need to consider universal access to AI in terms of both quantity and quality." (토큰 사용 증대가 직접적인 비용부담으로 작용하는 건 민간·공공 모두에게 숙제다. 특히 대대적인 노동시장 재편 흐름 속에서 개인들은 인공지능 역량을 쌓아야 한다는 거센 압박을 받고 있다. 이들을 각자도생의 정글에 방치하지 않으려면 공공의 지원이 필요하다. 김성우 박사는 “인공지능은 사용자들이 자유롭게 선택하는 서비스라기 보다 수도·전기 같은 필수 인프라지만, 공급자가 공공이 아닌 빅테크라고 봐야 할 것 같다”며 “경제적 조건에 따라 품질 차이가 큰 수돗물을 마시거나 전력 공급 안정성이 현저히 차이가 날 경우 사회 문제가 되는 것처럼 인공지능도 양·질에서 보편적인 접근권을 고려해봐야할 것 같다”고 말했다.)

However, voices urge caution, noting that enhancing equity in AI access through public support not only requires enormous budgets but could also result in funneling government funds to global Big Tech. The government's 'National Representative AI' project won't even select two development teams until next year, leaving a long time before commercialization. (하지만 공공지원을 통해 인공지능 접근권의 형평성을 높이는 문제는 막대한 예산이 필요할 뿐 아니라 글로벌 빅테크에 정부 예산을 쏟아붓는 것으로 귀결될 수 있어 신중해야 한다는 목소리가 나온다. 정부가 추진 중인 ‘국가대표 인공지능’ 프로젝트는 내년에야 개발 기업 2개팀을 선정하는 일정이라 상용화 단계까지 시간이 한참 남았다.)

Yoo Jae-yeon, chair of the social subcommittee under the National AI Strategy Committee, stated, "Rather than the state providing free AI passes, it's important to issue vouchers based on purpose and use," adding, "We are considering providing universal vouchers, especially for creators, where productivity gaps widen significantly based on AI usage levels." (국가인공지능전략위원회 유재연 사회분과위원장은 “국가가 인공지능 무료 사용권을 지급하는 것이 아니라 용도·목적에 따라 바우처를 지급하는 것이 중요하다”며 “인공지능 사용 수준에 따라 생산성 격차가 크게 벌어지는 창작자 중심으로 보편적 바우처를 지급하는 것을 검토중”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Joo-hyun, The Hankyoreh Human & Digital Research Institute edigna@hani.co.kr (이주현 한겨레 사람과디지털연구소 기자 edigna@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Using More Tokens Doesn't Mean You're Doing Good Work" (“토큰 많이 쓴다고 일 잘하는 건 아니다”)
item.description:
In Steven Spielberg's film 'Ready Player One,' characters risk their lives to earn 'coins' to survive in and outside the virtual world. In a world where AI is becoming an indispensable tool for studying, working, and playing, 'tokens' could similarly take on the status of movie coins. China recently changed the name of tokens to 'Ci Yuan' (word units), clearly signaling its intent to take the lead in the token economy. (스티븐 스필버그의 영화 ‘레디 플레이어 원’에는 가상현실 안팎의 세계에서 살아남기 위해 목숨 걸고 ‘코인’을 버는 사람들이 나온다. 공부하고 일하고 노는 데 인공지능이 필수불가결한 도구로 자리잡는 상황에선, ‘토큰’도 영화 속 코인 같은 위상을 지닐 수 있다. 중국은 최근 토큰 명칭을 ‘말(词)'의 화폐단위(元)'를 뜻하는 ‘츠위안’으로 변경하면서 토큰경제를 주도하겠다는 의지를 명확히 밝혔다.)

If you want an intuitive understanding of what a token is, try OpenAI's 'Tokenizer' (https://platform.openai.com/tokenizer). When we input text into a generative AI, the sentence is broken down into small pieces called 'tokens.' Typically, 4 English characters equal 1 token. The tokenizer calculates the sentence 'Tokens are becoming the digital rent' as 11 tokens (based on GPT-5). (토큰이 무엇인지 직관적으로 알고 싶다면 오픈에이아이의 ‘토크나이저’(https://platform.openai.com/tokenizer)에 들어가보라. 우리가 생성형 인공지능에 텍스트를 입력하면 문장은 작은 조각 ‘토큰’으로 분해된다. 통상 영어 4글자가 토큰 1개다. 토크나이저는 ‘토큰이 디지털 월세가 되고 있다’는 문장을 토큰 11개로 계산한다(GPT5 기준).)

Earlier this year, in Silicon Valley, token usage was seen as a metric for how hard developers were working, giving rise to a 'token maxing' culture. However, using more tokens doesn't guarantee better-quality results. According to a joint research paper by teams from the University of Michigan, Stanford, and others, titled 'How AI Agents Spend Your Money' (arXiv, published April 29), the total number of tokens for the same task can vary by up to 30 times between runs. (올해 초 실리콘밸리에선 토큰 사용량이 개발자들이 얼마나 열심히 일하는지를 알려주는 지표로 여겨지면서 ‘토큰 맥싱’ 문화가 등장하기도 했다. 하지만 토큰을 많이 사용한다고 해서 더 좋은 품질의 결과물이 나오는 건 아니다. 미시간대·스탠포드 등 공동연구팀의 논문 ‘인공지능 에이전트는 당신의 돈을 어떻게 쓰는가’(arXiv·4월29일 게재)를 보면, 인공지능은 같은 작업이라도 실행할 때마다 총 토큰 수가 최대 30배까지 달라질 수 있다.)

Additionally, accuracy was highest when token usage was at a moderate level. This is because when AI is instructed to perform difficult tasks requiring many tokens, it's more likely to engage in inefficient repetitive actions, such as continuously viewing and modifying the same file. The paper notes, 'AI models lack a mechanism to recognize when a task is unsolvable and stop early.' As a result, the paper points out that pricing for AI usage is not a simple issue. (또한 정확도는 토큰 사용량이 중간 수준일 때 가장 높았다. 인공지능이 토큰을 많이 필요로 하는 어려운 작업을 지시받으면 같은 파일을 계속 보고 수정하는 비효율적인 반복 행동을 할 가능성이 높아지기 때문이다. 논문은 “인공지능 모델은 과제가 해결 불가능하다는 점을 인식하고 일찍 멈추는 메커니즘이 부족하다”고 짚었다. 이 때문에 인공지능 사용료 책정은 간단한 문제가 아니라고 논문은 지적한다.)

Of course, token efficiency can improve with technological advancements. For example, Google's 'Gemini 3 Flash' is a lightweight model that significantly reduces token usage while maintaining excellent performance. (물론, 기술적 발전에 따라 토큰 효율은 개선될 수 있다. 가령 구글의 ‘제미나이 3 플래시'는 경량화 모델로 토큰 사용을 대폭 줄이면서도 우수한 성능을 갖춘 것으로 평가된다.)

By Lee Ju-hyun, Hankyoreh People and Digital Research Lab reporter edigna@hani.co.kr (이주현 한겨레 사람과디지털연구소 기자 edigna@hani.co.kr)

item.title: First 10 Days of May Exports Hit Record $18.4 Billion for the Period, Led by Semiconductors at 46% (5월 첫 열흘간 수출 184억달러 ‘같은 기간 역대 최대’…반도체 46%)
item.description:
South Korea's exports for the first 10 days of May reached the highest ever for the same period based on May data, driven by a surge in semiconductor exports. (5월1~10일 한국 수출이 반도체 수출액 증가로 5월 기준 동기간 역대 최대를 기록했다.)

The Korea Customs Service announced on the 11th that exports for the 1st to 10th of this month stood at $18.4 billion, a 43.7% increase from the same period last year, based on preliminary trade figures. This is an all-time high for the May 1-10 period. (관세청은 이달 1~10일 수출입 현황 잠정치를 집계한 결과 수출액이 184억달러로 전년 동기 대비 43.7% 증가했다고 11일 밝혔다. 5월 동기간 기준 역대 최대치다.)

Semiconductor exports posted their best performance for any May period, leading the overall export growth. Semiconductor exports totaled $8.5 billion, up 149.8% from a year earlier. The share of semiconductors in total exports rose to 46.3%, up 19.7 percentage points from the previous year. Exports also increased in semiconductors (149.8%), computer peripherals (382.8%), and petroleum products (2.4%), while passenger car exports declined by 26.0%. <<>>> Exports to China (81.8%), Vietnam (89.3%), the United States (17.9%), Taiwan (96.7%), and the European Union (11.3%) all grew. The combined export share to the top three countries (China, the United States, and Vietnam) stood at 55.3%. (반도체 수출이 5월 기준으로 역대 가장 좋은 실적을 기록하며 수출 증가세를 이끌었다. 반도체 수출액은 85억달러로 1년 전보다 149.8% 증가했다. 반도체가 전체 수출에서 차지하는 비중도 46.3%로 전년 대비 19.7%포인트 늘었다. 반도체(149.8%), 컴퓨터 주변기기(382.8%), 석유제품(2.4%) 등에서도 수출이 늘었고 승용차(-26.0%)는 감소했다.)

Imports during the same period totaled $16.7 billion, up 14.9% from a year earlier. Increases were seen in crude oil (7.9%), semiconductors (41.4%), semiconductor manufacturing equipment (129.7%), and petroleum products (100.8%), while machinery declined by 1.9%. Imports from China (28.8%), the United States (22.9%), the European Union (45.3%), Saudi Arabia (19.6%), and Japan (7.2%) increased. (수출국은 중국(81.8%), 베트남(89.3%), 미국(17.9%), 대만(96.7%), 유럽연합(11.3%) 등에서 증가했다. 상위 3국(중국·미국·베트남) 수출 비중은 55.3%로 집계됐다.)

The trade balance recorded a surplus of $1.7 billion, as exports exceeded imports. (같은 기간 수입액은 167억달러로 전년 대비 14.9% 증가했다. 원유(7.9%), 반도체(41.4%), 반도체 제조장비(129.7%), 석유제품(100.8%) 등에서 늘었고 기계류(-1.9%)에서 감소했다. 수입국은 중국(28.8%), 미국(22.9%), 유럽연합(45.3%), 사우디아라비아(19.6%), 일본(7.2%)에서 증가했다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jeong shin@hani.co.kr (무역수지는 수출액이 수입액보다 커 17억달러 흑자를 기록했다.)

item.title: KOSPI Breaks 7,800 Early in Session…U.S. Stock Market's 'Semiconductor Strength' Effect (코스피, 장 초반 7800 돌파…미국 증시 ‘반도체 강세’ 영향)
item.description:
Influenced by a broad rally in U.S. stocks, led by semiconductor shares over the past weekend, the KOSPI surged past the 7,800 mark early in the session on the 11th. Although U.S. President Donald Trump publicly criticized Iran's response overnight, putting end-of-war negotiations at risk of collapse, the domestic stock market appeared largely unaffected. (지난 주말 미국 증시가 반도체주를 중심으로 일제히 강세를 보인 영향으로 11일 코스피가 장 초반부터 7800선을 넘어섰다. 간밤 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 이란이 보낸 답변에 대해 공개 비판하며 종전 협상이 좌초 위기에 빠졌지만, 국내 증시는 큰 영향을 받지 않는 모습이다.)

According to data from the Korea Exchange, the KOSPI opened at 7,775.31, up 3.70% from the previous trading day, setting a new all-time high. It later widened its gain to over 4%, easily surpassing 7,800 in early trading. Since breaking through the 7,000 mark for the first time on the 6th, the KOSPI has been setting new records for four consecutive trading days. (한국거래소 수치를 보면, 코스피는 전 거래일 대비 3.70% 오른 7775.31로 출발하며 사상 최고치를 경신했다. 이후 4%대로 상승 폭을 넓히며 장 초반 7800을 훌쩍 넘어섰다. 코스피는 지난 6일 사상 첫 7000선을 넘어선 이래 4거래일 연속 최고 기록을 갈아치우고 있다.)

Top stocks by market capitalization on the KOSPI market are also showing a broad upward trend. As of 9:10 a.m., Samsung Electronics was trading at 286,500 won, up 6.70% from the previous session, while SK Hynix was soaring 9.85% to 1,852,000 won. SK Square, the intermediate holding company of SK Hynix, rose 6.83% to 1,173,000 won, overtaking Samsung Electronics' preferred shares to become the third-largest company by market cap. (유가증권시장에서 시가총액 상위 종목들도 일제히 오름세를 나타내고 있다. 오전 9시10분 기준 삼성전자는 전 거래일 대비 6.70% 오른 28만6500원에, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 9.85% 폭등한 185만2000원에 거래되고 있다. 에스케이하이닉스의 중간 지주사인 에스케이(SK)스퀘어는 6.83% 오른 117만3000원을 기록하며 삼성전자 우선주를 제치고 시가총액 3위로 올라섰다.)

This is analyzed as the result of a sharp rise in U.S. stocks, led by semiconductor stocks, over the past weekend. On the 8th (local time), the S&P 500 index and the Nasdaq index rose 0.84% and 1.71% respectively from the previous session, setting new all-time highs. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 5.51%. (지난 주말 미국 증시가 반도체주를 중심으로 급등한 영향을 받은 것으로 분석된다. 지난 8일(현지시각) 스탠더드앤드푸어스(S&P)500 지수와 나스닥 지수는 각각 전 거래일 대비 0.84%, 1.71% 오르며 사상 최고치 기록을 경신했다. 필라델피아 반도체 지수는 5.51% 급등했다.)

The KOSDAQ index opened at 1,212.88, up 0.43% from the previous session, but turned downward in early trading. The won-dollar exchange rate opened at 1,466.0 won, down 5.7 won from the previous session's closing price (3:30 p.m.). (코스닥 지수는 전 거래일 대비 0.43% 오른 1212.88에 개장했지만, 장 초반 하락세로 돌아섰다. 원-달러 환율은 전 거래일 종가(오후 3시30분)보다 5.7원 내린 1466.0원에 출발했다.)

Reporter Kim Ga-yoon gayoon@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Senior Reverse Mortgage Payments to Increase for Low-Priced Homes Starting June… Residency Requirement Also Eased (6월부터 저가 주택 주택연금 더 받는다…실거주 의무도 완화)
item.description:
Starting June 1, seniors who own low-priced homes valued under 180 million won will see an increase in their reverse mortgage payments, and the mandatory residency requirement for enrollment will also be relaxed. (오는 6월 1일부터 시가 1억8천만원 미만 저가 주택을 보유한 경우 주택연금 수령액이 늘어나고, 주택연금 가입 시 실거주 의무도 완화된다.)

The Korea Housing Finance Corporation announced on the 11th that it will implement these improvements to the reverse mortgage system starting next month. The changes apply to new applications filed from June 1. First, for those owning low-priced homes worth less than 180 million won, the preferential rate for monthly pension payments will rise. For example, an average preferential plan participant (age 77, home value 130 million won) with a standard home will see the preferential rate increase from the current 14.8% to 20.5%. The specific rate may vary depending on the type and price of the home and the participant's age. (한국주택금융공사는 다음 달 1일부터 이런 내용의 주택연금 제도 개선 방안을 시행한다고 11일 밝혔다. 이번 개선 방안은 다음 달 1일 신규 신청건부터 적용된다. 우선, 시가 1억8천만원 미만 저가주택을 보유한 경우 월 연금 수령액 우대율이 높아진다. 예컨대 우대형 평균 가입자(77살, 1억3천만원)가 일반 주택을 보유한 경우 주택연금 수령액 우대율이 기존 14.8%에서 20.5%로 높아진다. 구체적인 우대율은 주택 유형과 가격, 가입자 연령에 따라 달라질 수 있다.)

Additionally, couples who together own a single home will be eligible to enroll in the reverse mortgage without physically residing in the property if they have reasons such as hospitalization, caring for children, or moving into a senior welfare facility. Previously, enrollment required that the applicant actually live in the collateral home. It will also now be permitted to rent out the entire collateral home if the owner is not living there. (아울러 부부 합산 1주택자가 입원, 자녀 봉양, 노인주거복지시설 입주 등의 사유가 있을 경우 실거주하지 않더라도 연금 가입이 가능해진다. 지금까지는 가입 시점에 담보주택에 반드시 실거주해야 했다. 실거주하지 않는 경우 담보주택 전체를 임대하는 것도 허용된다.)

Furthermore, in cases where a parent enrolled in the reverse mortgage passes away, and a child inherits the home and wishes to re-enroll, the previous requirement to repay all pension benefits received with separate funds before reapplying has been eased. The new "Generational Bridge Reverse Mortgage" allows individuals aged 55 or older to use individual withdrawals to receive pension funds in advance to repay the debt. In other words, children applying for a reverse mortgage using the same home as collateral can utilize the system, which allows individual withdrawals (up to 90% of the loan limit), to pay off their parents' reverse mortgage obligations. (또 주택연금에 가입한 부모가 사망한 경우 해당 주택을 자녀가 상속받아 다시 가입하려면 기존에는 그동안 지급된 주택연금을 별도 자금을 마련해 먼저 상환해야 했는데, 이번에 ‘세대이음 주택연금’을 새로 출시해 만 55세 이상일 경우엔 개별인출로 연금을 미리 받아서 갚을 수 있게 됐다. 즉 동일 주택을 담보로 주택연금을 신청하는 자녀가 가입 시 개별인출(대출한도의 최대 90%까지)할 수 있는 제도를 활용해 부모의 주택연금 채무를 상환할 수 있게 된다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Gye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Requests Investigation of 5 Officials from Korea Expressway Corporation and Doseonghoe Over 'Rest Area Bidding Information Leak Allegations' (국토부, ‘휴게소 입찰 정보 유출 의혹' 도공·도성회 관계자 5명 수사 의뢰)
item.description:
The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport has requested an investigation into officials from the Korea Expressway Corporation (KEC) who are suspected of leaking bidding information for highway rest areas. (국토교통부가 고속도로 휴게소 입찰 정보 유출 의혹을 받는 한국도로공사(도공) 관계자 등을 수사 의뢰했다.)

On the 11th, the Ministry announced that it had requested the National Police Agency to investigate four KEC officials and the CEO of H&DE, a subsidiary of Doseonghoe, a retired KEC employees' association, totaling five individuals, based on the results of an audit of Doseonghoe and KEC. (국토부는 도공 퇴직자 모임인 ‘도성회’와 도공에 대한 감사 결과를 토대로 도공 관계자 4명과 도성회 자회사 에이치앤디이(H&DE) 대표 등 5명을 경찰청에 수사 의뢰했다고 11일 밝혔다.)

The Ministry explained that there are suspicions of misconduct, including the leakage of bidding information, related to the bidding for the Seonsan (Changwon) rest area facility, for which H&DE was selected as the project operator in August of last year. While the bidding notice for the facility was issued by KEC in May of last year, it was revealed that H&DE had reported the bidding information and plans for business participation to the Doseonghoe board two months earlier, in March. The Ministry also believes there is a possibility of the leakage of pricing information from bidding companies and collusion among them. (국토부는 지난해 8월 에이치앤디이가 사업시행자로 선정된 선산(창원) 휴게시설 입찰과 관련해서 입찰 정보 유출 등의 비위 의혹이 있다고 설명했다. 도공의 해당 시설 입찰 공고는 지난해 5월에 이뤄졌지만, 에이치앤디이는 두달 전인 3월 해당 입찰정보 및 사업참여계획을 도성회 이사회에 보고한 것으로 나타났다. 국토부는 입찰 참여업체 가격정보 유출 및 업체 간 담합 가능성도 있다고 보고 있다.)

Earlier, after conducting an audit starting in January, the Ministry announced that it had uncovered that Doseonghoe, a non-profit corporation, had focused on for-profit businesses such as operating highway rest area facilities through H&DE, that H&DE's profits were distributed to Doseonghoe and used for items like members' birthday bonuses, and that all executives, including the CEO of H&DE, were composed of Doseonghoe members. The Ministry stated it would request a tax investigation and a criminal probe. A Ministry official said, "We plan to actively cooperate with the investigation by providing audit materials and other support." (앞서 국토부는 지난 1월부터 감사를 벌인 결과 비영리법인인 도성회가 에이치앤디이를 통해 고속도로 휴게시설 운영 등 영리사업에 치중해온 점, 에이치앤디이의 수익금을 도성회에 배당해 회원 생일축하금 등으로 나눠 가진 점, 에이치앤디이의 대표이사를 비롯해 임원진을 모두 도성회 회원으로 구성한 점 등을 적발해 세무조사 및 수사 의뢰하겠다고 밝힌 바 있다. 국토부 관계자는 “감사자료 제공 등을 통해 수사에 적극 협조할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jung shin@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government to Conduct Full Investigation of 'Perfect Score Lottery Winners'... Searching for 'Family of 7' with False Residency (정부, ‘청약 만점 당첨자’ 전수조사…위장전입 ‘7인 대가족’ 찾는다)
item.description:
Mr. A and his wife, while living together with their second daughter in a Seoul home, falsely registered their first son, who lives in Incheon, as living with them. Despite their two-room apartment making it difficult for four people to actually live together, they listed themselves as a 'four-member household' on paper. They included their first son as a dependent and won a lottery for a housing unit in Paju through the general supply system under the points-based subscription, only to be caught as a case of 'false residency'. (ㄱ씨 부부는 둘째 딸과 서울 집에 함께 살면서 인천에서 사는 첫째 아들을 함께 사는 것처럼 위장전입시켰다. ㄱ씨 부부의 집은 방이 둘뿐이라 4명이 함께 살기 곤란한 상황인데도 서류상으로만 ‘네 식구’가 된 것이다. 이들은 첫째 아들을 부양가족으로 포함해 파주에서 분양하는 주택에 청약가점제 일반공급으로 당첨됐다가 ‘위장전입’ 사례로 적발됐다.)

Mr. B conspired with Ms. C to win a lottery for a housing unit in Incheon through the special supply for newlyweds, qualifying as a prospective newlywed couple. They proceeded with the contract and marriage registration. However, they later regained their single status through a court lawsuit seeking annulment of the marriage, claiming there was no discussion of marriage or shared life—only a marriage registration made solely for the purpose of the newlywed housing lottery. (ㄴ씨는 ㄷ씨와 공모해 예비신혼부부 자격으로 인천에서 공급하는 주택에 신혼부부 특별공급으로 청약해 당첨됐고, 계약과 혼인신고를 진행했다. 하지만 이후 이들은 법원에 혼인 무효 확인 소송을 통해 미혼자 신분을 회복했다. 신혼부부청약을 위해 혼인신고를 했을 뿐, 혼인에 대한 논의나 공동생활은 없었다는 이유였다.)

As cases like former Minister of Strategy and Finance nominee Lee Hae-hoon's emerge, where winners have abnormally high subscription points, the government has decided to conduct a concentrated investigation into fraudulent lottery winners. The focus will be on cases where families exist only on paper but do not actually live together. (이혜훈 전 기획예산처 장관 후보자의 사례처럼 청약 가점이 비정상적으로 높은 당첨자가 속출하면서 정부가 부정청약 당첨자에 대한 집중 조사를 실시하기로 했다. 서류상으로만 대가족이고 실제로는 같이 살지 않는 경우가 중점 적발 대상이다.)

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) and the Real Estate Oversight Task Force under the Office for Government Policy Coordination announced on the 11th that they will conduct a joint investigation with relevant ministries into fraudulent lottery winners, focusing on whether dependents actually reside in the claimed residence. The investigation targets all housing complexes in regulated areas like Seoul that have been on sale since July of last year, as well as all popular complexes in other areas. This includes a total of 43 complexes with 25,000 housing units. The main items under investigation include false residency, fake marriages or divorces, trading of subscription accounts or qualifications, document forgery, and other instances of suspected fraudulent subscriptions involving manipulated qualifications or conditions. (국토교통부와 국무조정실 부동산 감독 추진단은 관계부처 합동으로 부양가족의 실거주 여부 등 부정청약 당첨자를 집중 조사하기로 했다고 11일 밝혔다. 조사 대상단지는 지난해 7월 이후 분양한 서울 등 규제지역의 모든 분양단지와 그 외 기타지역 인기 분양단지 전부다. 여기에는 총 43개 단지, 2만5천가구가 포함된다. 주요 조사 사항은 위장전입, 위장결혼·이혼, 통장·자격매매, 문서 위조 등 청약자격과 조건을 조작한 부정청약 의심사례 전반이다.)

In particular, winners with perfect scores under the points-based subscription system are set to be key investigation targets. The points-based system calculates scores out of a total of 84 points based on the number of dependents (35 points), period of being housing-free (32 points), and duration of subscription account membership (17 points). The government plans to focus on the number of dependents. A perfect score is only possible for families with at least 7 members, including 6 or more dependents, and the government suspects that such cases may involve fraudulent practices like false residency. (특히 청약가점제 만점 통장 당첨자가 핵심 조사 대상이 될 계획이다. 청약가점제는 총 84점 만점으로 부양가족 수(35점)·무주택기간(32점)·청약통장 가입기간(17점)에 따라 점수가 산정된다. 정부는 이 가운데 부양가족 수를 중점적으로 조사할 계획이다. 부양가족이 6명 이상인 최소 7명의 대가족이어야만 만점 통장이 가능한데, 정부는 여기에 위장전입 등의 부정행위가 개입됐을 것이라고 의심하고 있다.)

To thoroughly verify the actual residence of dependents, the government plans to utilize various administrative data. It will confirm actual residence by checking the locations of hospitals and pharmacies used by parents through their three-year health insurance medical benefit records, and by examining the workplace locations of adult children through their health insurance eligibility confirmation certificates. The government will also additionally use all lease (jeonse and monthly rent) records and home ownership details of the dependents. (정부는 부양가족의 실거주 여부를 꼼꼼히 조사하기 위해 각종 행정 데이터를 활용할 계획이다. 부모의 3년간 건강보험 요양급여내역을 통해 실제 이용한 병원과 약국 소재지를 확인하는 방식으로 실거주지를 확인하고, 성인 자녀의 건강보험 자격득실확인서를 통해 직장소재지를 확인해 실거주지를 특정하는 식이다. 정부는 부양가족이 체결한 모든 전·월세 내역과 주택소유 여부도 추가로 활용하기로 했다.)

To facilitate this, the government will increase on-site inspection personnel from 8 to 15, and extend the inspection period per complex from the original 1 day to 3 to 5 days. The government also plans to strengthen the residency requirement from 1 year to 3 years to block short-term false residency tactics using adult children, and make it mandatory to submit adult children's health insurance eligibility confirmation certificates, among other systemic improvements. (이를 위해 정부는 현장점검 인력을 8명에서 15명으로 증원하고, 단지별 점검 기간도 당초 1일에서 3∼5일로 늘리기로 했다. 정부는 성인 자녀를 활용한 단기간 위장전입 편법을 차단하기 위해 거주요건을 1년에서 3년으로 강화하고, 성인 자녀의 건강보험 자격득실확인서 제출을 의무화하는 등의 제도개선도 함께 추진할 계획이다.)

"Once a case is confirmed as fraudulent subscription, we impose strong measures such as criminal punishment, including up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to 30 million won, contract cancellation (recovery of the housing unit), forfeiture of the down payment (10% of the sale price), and restriction of subscription eligibility for 10 years," said Jung Soo-ho, head of the Housing Fund Division at MOLIT. "We urge the public to be especially careful to avoid disadvantages in civil and criminal matters." The investigation results are scheduled to be announced at the end of June. (정수호 국토부 주택기금과장은 “부정청약으로 확정되는 경우 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만원 이하의 벌금 등 형사처벌, 계약취소(주택환수)와 계약금(분양가의 10%) 몰수, 10년간 청약자격 제한 등 강력한 조처를 취하고 있다”며 “민·형사상 불이익을 받지 않도록 각별히 주의해달라”고 당부했다. 조사 결과는 6월 말 발표 예정이다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (이지혜 기자 godot@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Myeongdong Department Stores Swarming with Foreigners… Lotte Shopping’s Q1 Operating Profit Surges 70% (명동 백화점 외국인 미어터지더니…롯데쇼핑 1분기 영업이익 70% 늘었다)
item.description:
Lotte Shopping showed strong performance, particularly in its department store division, successfully improving its first-quarter results. The rise in spending by foreign tourists especially drove the rebound in performance. (롯데쇼핑이 백화점 사업 부문을 중심으로 호조세를 보이며 1분기 실적 개선에 성공했다. 특히 외국인 관광객 소비 증가가 실적 반등을 이끌었다.)

Lotte Shopping announced on the 11th that it provisionally recorded sales of 3.5816 trillion won and an operating profit of 252.9 billion won on a consolidated basis for the first quarter. This represents increases of 3.6% and 70.6%, respectively, compared to the same period last year. (롯데쇼핑은 지난 1분기 연결 기준으로 매출 3조5816억원, 영업이익 2529억원을 거둔 것으로 잠정 집계됐다고 11일 공시했다. 이는 지난해 같은 기간보다 각각 3.6%, 70.6% 증가한 수치다.)

The department store division was the key driver of the strong Q1 results. Department store sales rose 8.2% year-on-year to 872.3 billion won, driven by a 19% increase in sales at large stores such as the main branch, Jamsil branch, and Busan main branch. (1분기 실적 호조를 이끈 것은 백화점 사업부다. 백화점 매출은 전년 동기 대비 8.2% 늘어난 8723억원을 기록했는데, 본점·잠실점·부산본점 등 대형 점포 매출이 19% 늘어난 영향이다.)

In particular, sales from foreign tourists surged by 92%, contributing to a 13% rise in existing store sales. At the Myeongdong main branch, sales from foreigners increased by 103% compared to the same period last year, and their share of total sales expanded to 23%. The company stated it plans to continue efforts to strengthen foreign tourist sales in the second quarter. (특히 외국인 관광객 매출도 92% 급증하면서 기존 점포 매출 상승(13%↑)에 기여했다. 명동 본점은 지난해 동기보다 외국인 매출이 103% 증가했고, 전체 매출에서 차지하는 비중도 23%까지 확대됐다. 회사 쪽은 2분기에도 외국인 관광객 매출 강화를 위해 노력할 계획이라고 밝혔다.)

The mart division posted Q1 sales of 1.5256 trillion won and an operating profit of 33.8 billion won. The strong performance of its Vietnam operations drove the improvement in the mart division’s results. Domestic mart operations recorded an operating profit of 8.8 billion won, up 30.9% year-on-year, thanks to reduced selling and administrative expenses. Overseas mart operations, primarily in Vietnam, continued their growth trend, achieving sales of 485 billion won and an operating profit of 25 billion won. (마트 사업부는 1분기 매출 1조5256억원, 영업이익 338억원을 거뒀다. 베트남 사업 호조가 마트 사업부 실적 개선을 견인했다. 국내 마트 사업은 판관비 절감 효과 등으로 영업이익이 전년동기 대비 30.9% 증가한 88억원을 기록했다. 국외 마트 사업도 베트남을 중심으로 성장세를 이어가면서 매출 4850억원, 영업이익 250억원을 올렸다.)

Home shopping reported an operating profit of 26.5 billion won for Q1, a 118.6% increase year-on-year, driven by expanded sales of high-profit products centered on health foods and beauty items. (홈쇼핑은 1분기 영업이익 265억원을 기록했는데, 건강식품과 뷰티 중심의 고수익 상품 판매 확대 영향으로 전년 같은 기간 대비 영업이익이 118.6% 증가했다.)

In contrast, the e-commerce division (Lotte ON) posted losses for the ninth consecutive quarter. However, operating losses narrowed to 5.8 billion won, a decrease of 2.7 billion won from last year, due to improved profitability focused on fashion and beauty, as well as increased advertising revenue. (반면 이커머스 사업부(롯데온)는 9개 분기 연속 적자를 이어갔다. 다만 패션, 뷰티 중심의 수익성 개선과 광고 수익 확대 영향으로 영업 손실은 58억원을 기록했으며 이는 지난해보다 27억원 줄어든 수치다.)

Lotte Hi-Mart saw both sales and operating profit decline in Q1, affected by a sluggish domestic home appliance market and a decrease in new move-in volume. Operating losses expanded to 14.7 billion won, widening the deficit compared to the same period last year. (롯데하이마트는 국내 가전 시장 침체와 신규 입주 물량 감소 영향으로 1분기 매출과 영업이익 모두 감소했다. 영업손실은 147억원으로 전년 동기 대비 적자 폭이 확대됐다.)

item.title: First-quarter household loans at top 5 banks decrease by 178%…Impact of total loan management and real estate regulations (5대 은행 1분기 가계대출 178% 감소…총량 관리·부동산 규제 영향)
item.description:
Amid the financial authorities' strengthened management of total household loans and a continued stance on real estate loan regulations, household loans at the top five banks decreased by nearly 180% in the first quarter compared to their annual increase targets. (금융당국의 가계대출 총량 관리 강화와 부동산 대출 규제 기조 속에 5대 은행의 1분기 가계대출이 올해 연간 증가 목표치보다 오히려 180%가까이 감소했다.)

According to data from the Financial Supervisory Service received by Rep. Lee In-young of the Democratic Party of Korea (Political Affairs Committee) on the 11th, KB Kookmin Bank's household loan performance at the end of the first quarter of this year was recorded at -178.0% compared to the annual loan increase target (based on its own management plan, excluding policy loans). KB Kookmin Bank's target for household loan growth this year submitted to the financial authorities was 909.2 billion won, but it actually decreased by 1.6143 trillion won. NH Nonghyup Bank also saw a decrease of 1.3551 trillion won (-156.0%) compared to this year's growth target (870 billion won), while Shinhan Bank saw a reduction of 1.5896 trillion won (-187.0%) compared to its target (850 billion won) in the first quarter. (11일 이인영 더불어민주당 의원(정무위원회)이 금융감독원에서 받은 자료에 따르면 케이비(KB)국민은행의 올해 1분기 말 가계대출 실적은 연간 대출 증가 목표치(자체 경영계획 기준, 정책성 대출상품 제외) 대비 -178.0%로 집계됐다. 국민은행이 금융당국에 제출한 올해 가계대출 증가액 목표치는 9092억원이었으나 오히려 1조6143억원 감소했다. 엔에이치(NH)농협은행도 올해 증가 목표치(8700억원)에 견줘 실제로는 1조3551억원(-156.0%) 감소했고, 신한은행도 목표치(8500억원)에 비해 1분기에 1조5896억원(-187.0%) 줄었다.)

Hana Bank and Woori Bank recorded first-quarter household loan decreases of 1.5402 trillion won and 344.7 billion won, respectively, corresponding to -175.0% and -41.7% compared to their annual growth targets. Banks appear to have conservatively issued loans before the financial authorities finalized the total household loan management targets for this year in April. (하나은행과 우리은행의 1분기 가계대출액 감소 규모는 각각 1조5402억원, 3447억원으로 연간 증가 목표치 대비 각각 -175.0%, -41.7%를 기록했다. 은행들은 올해 가계대출 총량 관리 목표치가 금융당국에서 확정(4월)되기 전까지 보수적으로 대출을 집행한 것으로 보인다.)

The total household loan growth target for the top five banks and internet-only banks this year is 1.5%, lower than last year's 1.7%. The growth targets for the top five banks are estimated to be 60-70% of the overall bank target. This year, the authorities established separate management targets for mortgage loans and set ratios considering each bank's past mortgage loan performance. (올해 5대 은행 및 인터넷전문은행의 전체 가계대출 총량 증가율 목표치는 1.5%로 전년도(1.7%) 보다 낮아졌다. 5대 은행의 증가율 목표치는 전체 은행 목표치의 60∼70% 수준으로 파악됐다. 당국은 올해 주택담보대출의 경우 별도 관리 목표를 신설하고, 은행별 과거 주담대 실적을 고려해 비율을 설정했다.)

Internet-only banks are also reducing loans. K Bank's target this year was 667.3 billion won, but in the first quarter, it actually decreased by 223.7 billion won. Kakao Bank executed 205.2 billion won (52.0%) of its target of 396.5 billion won, and Toss Bank executed only 37 billion won (7.0%) of its target of 550.2 billion won. A financial authority official stated, "In the first quarter, loans are typically administered conservatively, and with ongoing real estate loan regulations, the loan amount itself has also decreased." (인터넷전문은행도 대출을 축소하는 흐름이다. 케이뱅크는 올해 목표치가 6673억인데 1분기에 오히려 2237억원 감소했고, 카카오뱅크는 목표치 3965억원 중 2052억원(52.0%), 토스뱅크는 목표치 5502억원 중 370억원(7.0%)만 집행됐다. 금융당국 관계자는 “1분기에는 통상적으로 대출을 보수적으로 집행하는 데다 부동산 대출 규제가 이어지면서 대출 금액 자체가 줄어든 영향도 있다”고 말했다.)

While bank loans are decreasing, the so-called 'balloon effect' of loans increasing to secondary financial sectors such as mutual finance has not yet appeared. Community credit cooperatives (Saemaeul Geumgo), which received a penalty of '0% net increase' in household loans this year, along with regional agricultural cooperatives (Nonghyup) and credit unions (Shinhyup), are sequentially restricting household loans for non-members. (은행 대출이 줄어드는 반면에 상호금융 등 2금융권으로 대출이 증가하는 ‘풍선효과’는 현재까지 나타나지 않고 있다. 올해 가계대출 ‘순증 0%’ 페널티를 받은 새마을금고를 비롯해 지역 단위농협, 신협 등은 잇따라 비회원(비조합원) 가계대출을 제한하고 있다.)

Senior Correspondent Jo Gye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Professor Chan-Woo Lee's Research Team at Kookmin University Elucidates Ruthenium-Titania Heterointerface Catalyst Mechanism for Enhancing Hydrogen Production Efficiency in Alkaline Water Electrolysis (국민대 이찬우 교수 연구팀, 알칼라인 수전해 수소 생산 효율 높이는 루테늄·티타이아 이종계면 촉매 메커니즘 규명)
item.description:
A research team led by Professor Chan-Woo Lee from the Department of Chemistry at Kookmin University (President Seung-Ryeol Jeong) has developed a ruthenium-titania (RuO₂/TiO₂) heterostructure catalyst that highly promotes the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in alkaline water electrolysis. The team elucidated its core operating principle through real-time Raman spectroscopy and theoretical calculations. By uniformly forming ruthenium oxide nanoparticles approximately 2 nm in size on a 25 nm titania support, the team created a heterointerface that rapidly promotes the water-splitting reaction. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) 화학과 이찬우 교수 연구팀이 알칼라인 수전해에서 수소 발생 반응(HER)을 고효율로 촉진하는 루테늄-티타니아(RuO₂/TiO₂) 이종구조 촉매를 개발하고, 그 핵심 작동 원리를 실시간 라만 분광법과 이론 계산을 통해 규명했다. 연구팀은 약 2nm 크기의 루테늄 산화물 나노입자를 25nm 크기의 티타니아 지지체 위에 균일하게 형성해 물 분해 반응을 빠르게 촉진하는 이종계면을 구현했다.)

Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) is gaining attention as a next-generation hydrogen production technology because it operates in an alkaline environment, reducing the reliance on expensive platinum group catalysts and corrosion-resistant components. However, under alkaline conditions, the initial step of breaking the O–H bond of water molecules to form hydrogen intermediates proceeds slowly, leading to high overpotentials for the hydrogen evolution reaction and reduced energy efficiency. Therefore, for the commercialization of water electrolysis, it is crucial to design catalysts that can lower the water activation energy barrier and to gain a direct understanding of the interfacial reaction mechanism. (음이온 교환막 수전해(AEMWE)는 알칼라인 환경에서 작동해 고가의 백금족 촉매와 내식성 부품 의존도를 낮출 수 있는 차세대 수소 생산 기술로 주목받고 있다. 그러나 알칼라인 조건에서는 물 분자의 O–H 결합을 끊어 수소 중간체를 만드는 초기 단계가 느리게 진행돼 수소 발생 반응의 과전압이 높아지고 에너지 효율이 저하되는 한계가 있다. 이에 따라 수전해 상용화를 위해서는 물 활성화 에너지 장벽을 낮출 수 있는 촉매 설계와 계면 반응 메커니즘에 대한 직접적인 이해가 중요하다.)

The research team designed the RuO₂/TiO₂ heterostructure catalyst by combining ruthenium-based materials, which are attracting attention as alternatives to platinum catalysts, with titania, which possesses water activation functionality. RuO₂ nanoparticles were deposited onto anatase TiO₂ nanoparticles, which had surface defects introduced through hydrogen peroxide treatment, using a hydrothermal synthesis method with RuCl₃ precursor. This formed a heterointerface where ruthenium oxide and titania are in close contact without the need for additional high-temperature heat treatment. During the electrochemical hydrogen evolution process, the catalyst surface is partially reduced and restructured into an active interface in the form of Ru/RuO₂/TiO₂₋ₓ(OH)y. It was confirmed that the reduced titania and Ti–OH functional groups formed during this process promote the adsorption and dissociation of water molecules. (연구팀은 백금 대체 촉매로 주목받는 루테늄 기반 소재와 물 활성화 기능을 가진 티타니아를 결합한 RuO₂/TiO₂ 이종구조 촉매를 설계했다. 과산화수소 처리로 표면 결함을 도입한 아나타제 TiO₂ 나노입자 위에 RuCl₃ 전구체를 이용해 RuO₂ 나노입자를 수열 합성 방식으로 증착했으며, 별도의 고온 열처리 없이도 루테늄 산화물과 티타니아가 긴밀하게 접촉한 이종계면을 형성했다. 전기화학적 수소 발생 과정에서 촉매 표면은 부분적으로 환원돼 Ru/RuO₂/TiO₂₋ₓ(OH)y 형태의 활성 계면으로 재구성되며, 이 과정에서 형성되는 환원 티타니아와 Ti–OH 작용기가 물 분자의 흡착과 분해를 촉진하는 것으로 확인됐다.)

The developed RuO₂/TiO₂ catalyst required an overpotential of only 6.6 mV to reach a current density of 10 mA cm⁻² in a 1 M KOH electrolyte. This performance is superior not only to pure RuO₂ (79 mV) but also to the commercial benchmark catalyst Pt/C (43 mV). Additionally, it exhibited a low Tafel slope of 36.7 mV dec⁻¹, demonstrating a significant improvement in the kinetics of the alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction. It recorded a high turnover frequency (TOF) of 25.07 s⁻¹ at an overpotential of 100 mV, indicating outstanding active site utilization among reported ruthenium-based alkaline hydrogen evolution catalysts. Its mass activity was also approximately 10 times and 6.4 times higher than that of RuO₂ and Pt/C, respectively. (개발된 RuO₂/TiO₂ 촉매는 1 M KOH 전해질에서 10 mA cm⁻²의 전류밀도에 도달하는 데 필요한 과전압이 6.6 mV에 불과했다. 이는 단독 RuO₂(79 mV)는 물론 상용 기준 촉매인 Pt/C(43 mV)보다도 우수한 성능이다. 또한 36.7 mV dec⁻¹의 낮은 Tafel 기울기를 보여 알칼라인 수소 발생 반응의 속도론이 크게 개선됐음을 입증했으며, 100 mV 과전압에서 25.07 s⁻¹의 높은 turnover frequency(TOF)를 기록해 보고된 루테늄 기반 알칼라인 수소 발생 촉매 가운데서도 매우 우수한 활성 사이트 활용도를 나타냈다. 질량활성 역시 RuO₂와 Pt/C 대비 각각 약 10배, 6.4배 높았다.)

Importantly, the significance of this study extends beyond improving catalyst performance; it directly verifies how water is activated at the heterointerface. The research team applied shell-isolated nanoparticle-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SHINERS) to track the changes in interfacial water molecules, adsorbed hydrogen (*H), and hydroxide intermediates (*OH) under actual HER operating conditions. The results showed that on the RuO₂/TiO₂ catalyst, highly reactive interfacial water species, such as water coordinated with K⁺ (K⁺-H₂O) and weakly hydrogen-bonded water (2-HB-H₂O), were increased. Concurrently, Ti–OH signals were also observed. This demonstrates that the titania interface plays a role in attracting water molecules and facilitating O–H bond cleavage. (특히 이번 연구는 촉매 성능 향상에 그치지 않고, 이종계면에서 물이 어떻게 활성화되는지를 직접 확인했다는 점에서 의미가 크다. 연구팀은 shell-isolated nanoparticle-enhanced Raman spectroscopy(SHINERS)를 적용해 실제 HER 작동 조건에서 계면 물 분자, 흡착 수소(*H), 수산화 중간체(*OH)의 변화를 추적했다. 그 결과 RuO₂/TiO₂ 촉매에서는 K⁺와 배위된 물(K⁺-H₂O) 및 약하게 수소 결합된 물(2-HB-H₂O)과 같은 반응성이 높은 계면 물 종이 증가했으며, Ti–OH 신호도 함께 관찰됐다. 이는 티타니아 계면이 물 분자를 끌어당기고 O–H 결합 절단을 쉽게 만드는 역할을 한다는 점을 보여준다.)

DFT calculations further supported these experimental findings. In a model where reduced and hydroxylated titania clusters were bound to a Ru surface, water molecules were preferentially adsorbed near the Ti–OH functional groups, and the activation barrier for water dissociation was significantly lowered compared to a pure Ru surface. Charge density analysis confirmed that charge redistribution occurs at the Ru/TiO₂ interface, stabilizing water adsorption, while Ru is responsible for the adsorption of hydrogen intermediates and the formation of hydrogen molecules, providing a cooperative reaction pathway. This result demonstrates at the molecular level that the ruthenium-titania heterointerface goes beyond merely modulating the electronic structure and actively promotes water activation itself, which is the bottleneck step in the alkaline HER. (DFT 계산 역시 이러한 실험 결과를 뒷받침했다. 환원 및 수산화된 티타니아 클러스터가 Ru 표면에 결합한 모델에서 물 분자는 Ti–OH 작용기 근처에 우선 흡착됐고, Ru 단독 표면에 비해 물 분해 활성화 장벽이 크게 낮아지는 것으로 나타났다. 전하 밀도 분석에서는 Ru와 TiO₂ 계면에서 전하 재분포가 일어나 물 흡착을 안정화하고, Ru는 수소 중간체의 흡착과 수소 분자 형성을 담당하는 협동적 반응 경로를 제공함을 확인했다. 이는 루테늄-티타니아 이종계면이 단순히 전자구조를 조절하는 수준을 넘어, 알칼라인 HER의 병목 단계인 물 활성화 자체를 촉진한다는 점을 분자 수준에서 입증한 결과다.)

Professor Chan-Woo Lee stated, "This study is significant not only for developing a highly active catalyst but also for directly observing the process by which the heterointerface activates water molecules under actual operating conditions." He added, "Based on the principle that water activation and hydrogen intermediate formation occur via a separate but cooperative mechanism at the ruthenium-titania interface, we will be able to propose a high-efficiency catalyst design strategy applicable to next-generation alkaline and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis systems." (이찬우 교수는 “이번 연구는 고활성 촉매 개발과 동시에 실제 작동 조건에서 이종계면이 물 분자를 활성화하는 과정을 직접 관찰했다는 데 의미가 있다”며 “루테늄-티타니아 계면에서 물 활성화와 수소 중간체 형성이 분리·협동적으로 일어나는 원리를 바탕으로 차세대 알칼라인 및 음이온 교환막 수전해 시스템에 적용 가능한 고효율 촉매 설계 전략을 제시할 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

This research was supported by the Excellent Young Researcher Grant (RS-2023-00210114), the Green Hydrogen Technology Self-Reliance Project (RS-2025-02304646), and the Global TOP Strategic Research Center Support Program (GTL25021-210) funded by the Ministry of Science and ICT. The research findings were published in the international academic journal Carbon Energy (IF 24.2, top 2.9% in JCR) under the title "Ruthenium-Titania Interface-Mediated Water Activation for High Turnover Frequency in Alkaline Hydrogen Evolution." (이번 연구는 과학기술정보통신부 재원의 우수신진연구(RS-2023-00210114), 그린수소기술자립프로젝트(RS-2025-02304646), 글로벌 TOP 전략연구단 지원사업(GTL25021-210)의 지원을 받아 수행됐다. 연구 결과는 에너지·소재·물리화학 분야 국제학술지 Carbon Energy(IF 24.2, JCR 상위 2.9%)에 “Ruthenium-Titania Interface-Mediated Water Activation for High Turnover Frequency in Alkaline Hydrogen Evolution”라는 제목으로 게재됐다.)

item.title: S-Oil Q1 Operating Profit Reaches 1.23 Trillion Won… Why the Refining Industry Downplays the ‘Inventory Effect’ (에쓰오일 1분기 영업익 1조2300억…정유업계, ‘재고 효과’에 선 긋는 이유)
item.description:
S-Oil achieved an operating profit of 1.23 trillion won in the first quarter of this year, turning to profit compared to the same period last year. Due to soaring petroleum product prices from the US-Israel/Iran war, the company benefited from the effect of previously cheaply purchased crude oil inventory. (에쓰오일이 올해 1분기 1조2300억원에 달하는 영업이익을 달성했다. 전년 같은 기간 대비 흑자 전환이다. 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁으로 석유제품 가격이 급등하며 기존에 싸게 사들였던 원유 재고 효과를 봤다.)

On the 11th, S-Oil announced in a regulatory filing that its first-quarter operating profit (consolidated basis) was provisionally tallied at 1.2311 trillion won, turning to profit from an operating loss of 21.5 billion won in the same period last year. Sales fell by 0.5% year-on-year to 8.9427 trillion won. S-Oil stated, “Although refining margins were partially offset by facility maintenance shutdowns and the implementation of the maximum petroleum product price system, the profit in the refining sector improved compared to the previous quarter due to the lagging effect.” The lagging effect refers to the time difference between the purchase of crude oil and the production and sale of petroleum products, where margins expand when crude oil prices rise and shrink when crude oil prices fall. (에쓰오일은 11일 오전 올해 1분기 영업이익(연결 기준)이 1조2311억원으로, 지난해 같은 기간(영업손실 215억원)에 견줘 흑자 전환한 것으로 잠정 집계됐다고 공시했다. 매출은 8조9427억원으로 전년 동기 대비 0.5% 줄었다. 에쓰오일은 “시설 정기보수 및 석유 최고가격제 시행으로 정제마진이 일부 상쇄됐지만, 래깅 효과로 인해 정유부문 이익이 전분기 대비 개선됐다”고 밝혔다. 래깅 효과란 원유 구입 시점과 석유제품 생산·판매 시점 차이에서 발생하는 시차 효과로, 원유 가격 상승 때 마진이 확대되고 원유 가격이 하락할 때 마진이 줄게 된다.)

S-Oil analyzed that more than half of its operating profit—643.4 billion won—was due to the lagging effect from rising international oil prices. The company purchased crude oil cheaply in January and February, but from March, when the Middle East conflict intensified, petroleum product prices surged, causing a spike in complex refining margins. The monthly operating profit trend at S-Oil clearly reveals the lagging effect. Operating profit, which stood at 176.6 billion won in January and 242.4 billion won in February, surged to 812.2 billion won in March alone. S-Oil noted, “The blockade of the Strait of Hormuz disrupted crude oil supply, reducing petroleum product output and significantly widening the spreads for kerosene and diesel (the price difference between crude oil and petroleum products), raising refining margins.” (에쓰오일은 영업이익의 절반 이상인 6434억원이 국제 유가 상승에 따른 래깅 효과라고 분석했다. 1~2월에 싸게 원유를 사 왔는데, 중동전쟁이 본격화한 3월부터 석유제품 가격이 급등하며 복합 정제마진이 폭등했다. 에쓰오일 월별 영업이익 흐름을 보면, 래깅 효과가 명확히 드러난다. 1월 1766억원, 2월 2424억원이던 영업이익은 3월 한 달 8122억원으로 급증했다. 에쓰오일은 “호르무즈해협 봉쇄로 원유 수급 차질로 인한 석유제품 공급 감소가 등유·경유 스프레드(원유와 석유제품 가격 차이)를 대폭 확대시켜 정제마진이 상승했다”고 했다.)

S-Oil expects that in the second quarter, the price increase effect of petroleum products will outweigh any demand slowdown caused by high oil prices. However, it added, “If oil prices decline in the future, there is a downside risk to operating profit due to inventory-related losses and the lagging effect.” If the US and Iran reach an agreement to end the war, the situation would reverse, requiring the company to produce products from expensively purchased crude oil and sell them at lower prices. (에쓰오일은 2분기에도 고유가로 인한 수요 둔화보다 석유제품 가격 상승효과가 더 클 것으로 전망했다. 다만 “향후 유가가 하락하면 재고 관련 손실 및 래깅 효과 등으로 영업이익 하방 리스크가 있다”고 했다. 미국-이란이 종전에 합의하게 되면, 지금과는 반대로 비싸게 사들인 원유로 제품을 만들어 싸게 팔아야 한다.)

Following S-Oil, SK Innovation, GS Caltex, and HD Hyundai Oilbank are also expected to post operating profits of trillions of won in the first quarter. This trend is anticipated to continue into the second quarter. The refining industry is downplaying the strong performance, calling it merely a temporary lagging effect, as companies experienced a rollercoaster of operating profits and losses during the Russia-Ukraine war in 2022. The release of multi-trillion-won operating profits also comes at a burdensome time, coinciding with the government’s full-scale implementation of compensation for refinery losses under the maximum petroleum product price system. The government plans to compensate based on production costs, but the refining industry argues that due to the nature of the production process—where multiple petroleum products are sequentially extracted from crude oil—it is impossible to allocate costs to individual products. However, with companies posting trillions of won in operating profits, some assess that it has become difficult to actively justify business losses from the maximum price system. (에쓰오일에 이어 에스케이(SK) 이노베이션, 지에스(GS)칼텍스, 에이치디(HD)현대오일뱅크도 1분기 조 단위 영업이익이 예상된다. 이런 흐름은 2분기에도 이어질 전망이다. 정유업계는 일단 ‘일시적 래깅 효과에 불과하다’며 호실적을 되레 평가절하하는 분위기다. 2022년 러시아-우크라이나 전쟁 때도 영업이익·손실 롤러코스터를 탔던 경험이 있기 때문이다. 석유 최고가격제 시행에 따른 정부의 정유사 손실 보상 작업이 본격화하는 시점과 맞물려 수조원에 이르는 영업이익 발표를 내놓는 것도 부담이다. 정부는 ‘생산 원가 기준’으로 보전하겠다는 방침인데, 정유업계는 원유에서 여러 석유제품을 연속해서 뽑아내는 생산공정 특성상 제품별 원가를 산정하는 것은 불가능하다는 입장이다. 다만 조 단위 영업이익을 거두는 상황에서, 최고가격제 시행에 따른 기업 손실을 적극적으로 소명하기 어려운 상황이 됐다는 평가가 나온다.)
